description: Territorial authority to Accommodation Supplement area crosswalk. Each row gives one territorial authority's population shares across Areas 1-4; the atomic geography support multiplies Chronicle territorial-authority population by these shares, households draw one territorial authority by area unit, and the area columns derive from it. Area membership is defined by Work and Income on 2017 Statistical Area Unit names, not territorial authorities, so a share is the population of the authority's area units in each area divided by the authority's population. Where an authority spans areas the population-weighted split is a declared assumption (MC9).
status_reason: Rows computed from hash-pinned public Stats NZ SA1 2023 Census centroids/URP, AU2017 polygons and TA2025 polygons. Whole-SA1 centroid allocation and reported nearest-boundary repairs are declared approximations, not an official concordance. Queenstown urban area remains unmatched; its proposed extra extent is a separate sensitivity awaiting hub review. Location-heading conflicts are reported without changing exact name matches.

central.weights: usually resident population of each territorial authority's 2017 area units in each Accommodation Supplement area

alternative.description: assign the whole territorial authority to the area holding its largest population share; a tie is refused for review, never broken silently

effective_period.note: The 1 April 2018 definitions cover the whole model year. The Budget 2025 area redraw takes effect in April 2027, after it (targets doc H4c, a search-snippet citation).

assignment_rule.point: SA1 2023 centroid, whole-SA1 population assigned to AU2017 and TA2025 independently
assignment_rule.containment: Global even-odd parity over every ring of a feature, including nested rings supplied as separate MultiPolygon parts (observed for Motutangi-Kareponia enclosing Awanui). Disjoint parts are equivalent to their union. Boundary included with angular epsilon 1e-10 degrees. Every feature hit is inspected. Interior overlaps are repaired only when the point is within 20 m of every candidate boundary: choose the uniquely deepest interior (greatest boundary distance); tied distances within 1e-6 m or deeper overlaps refuse. Every candidate distance and selected code is reported. The 20 m sliver limit accommodates the approximately 10 m server simplification and 6-decimal rounding. Multiple boundary-only hits choose smallest code and are reported.
assignment_rule.no_hit: Nearest polygon boundary in local equirectangular metres (Earth radius 6371008.8); positive population refuses beyond 20000 m; zero population may use an unlimited nearest boundary. Equal nearest distances within 1e-6 m refuse. All no-hit assignments reported.
assignment_rule.zero_population_ta: Area Outside Territorial Authority (999), if zero population, is explicitly represented by Area 4 share 1, modal 4; this is a non-population placeholder, not an estimated share.

heading_ta_expectations_note: Review flags compare town/Zone headings to their primary TA, not asserted AS boundaries. Adjacent-district area units can be legitimate and are reported without changing exact matches. Other locations has no territorial implication and is recorded without a conflict check.

queenstown_sensitivity.label: sensitivity only; not the central assignment rule
queenstown_sensitivity.definition: Within Queenstown-Lakes District, otherwise unlisted AU2017 names containing Frankton or Queenstown are assigned Area 1
